summary: Flat residential kerb near a cul-de-sac bend, homes 17-22 m away.

best_section.where: Thorpe Street north kerb, just uphill of the bend, past the vacant block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 17-22 m away, homes on both sides; none within 10 m of this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but it is a plain residential street with no van stays.

sun_shade: Mostly open; a tree shades the kerb around 45 m from the south-west.
